title: ParkedResumeRequest
description:
The keyed dispatch a parked run's owner (`factory` or `agent-runner`) sends to resume it after a wake event (D115). Fulfils demand `platform-vault-20260930-contracts-d115-parked-work`.

**At most one resume per event.** `dispatch.dispatchKey` is DERIVED, never minted fresh: `"resume:" + lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of waitId + "\n" + eventKey` (71 characters, inside the dispatch-key pattern). The same wait and event therefore always produce the same key, so a duplicate event or an owner restart replays the existing run (`200`) or conflicts (`409`) under `runner.dispatch-reservation`; it never starts a second run. Worked example: waitId `wait-plantpal-pr-92` and eventKey `ci-run:plantpal:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567:88001` give key `resume:66b97d2f1a23c21f2e0f69279d8f63bb86ef13a035bb8c7fc8b85aabd2055306`.

**The resume carries the outcome.** `event` is the full `parked.condition-event`, and `action` says what the resumed agent must do with it: `continue` (the wait was satisfied: CI succeeded, PR merged, repository created, decision approved, demands satisfied), `fix` (the work failed: CI `failure`/`cancelled`/`timed-out` -> 'fix the failure', not 'continue'), or `reassess` (the world changed the plan: PR closed unmerged, decision rejected, a demand archived). `resumeNote` is copied from the parked run result; `dispatch.prompt` is the prompt the resumed run receives and is expected to contain the note and the outcome.

Deterministic next steps (for example a deploy command after a merge) run as commands, not as a resumed agent, and need no resume request.

dispatch.description: The keyed `POST /dispatch` body. `dispatchKey` is REQUIRED here and is the derived key described above.
